sloka: यदा तु एतत् वनम् घोरम् रामो दशरथ आत्मजः ।आगमिष्यति दुर्धर्षः तदा पूता भविष्यसि ॥१-४८-३२॥
transliteration: yadā tu etat vanam ghoram rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ ।āgamiṣyati durdharṣaḥ tadā pūtā bhaviṣyasi ॥1-48-32॥

translations.english: 'O Wickednatured one by offering hospitality to Rama, without covetousness and passion, you will happily live with me by regaining your present form'.
